subject: CFont text rendering pipeline — glyph table, colour stack, and screen text format
overview: CFont provides the game's 2D text rasterizer. All on-screen text (HUD, subtitles, radar blips, menus) passes through CFont::PrintString. The class maintains a global state stack (colour, scale, slant) that is set immediately before each PrintString call. Subtitle text is a separate codepath using CSubtitles which calls into CFont.

font_ids.description: GTA:SA uses numbered font slots. The font ID is set via CFont::SetFontStyle before any PrintString call.

FONT_PRICEDOWN.description: GTA Pricedown display face (used for wanted level digits, loading screens)

glyph_table.description: Each font is a TXD containing a single texture atlas. Glyph cells are arranged in a fixed grid; CFont maps character codes to UV rectangles using an array of 256 CCharDesc entries.

fields.name: m_fU
fields.description: Left UV coordinate in font atlas [0-1]

fields.name: m_fV
fields.description: Top UV coordinate in font atlas [0-1]

fields.name: m_fWidth
fields.description: UV width of the glyph cell

colour_stack.description: CFont maintains a 3-entry colour stack. CFont::SetColor sets the active colour; embedded colour codes in the string (~r~, ~g~, ~b~, ~y~, ~w~) push/pop from this stack at render time. The colour is a packed ABGR uint32 value.

colour_code_tokens.~n~: Newline — advances Y by line height
colour_code_tokens.~t~: Tab — advances X to next tab stop (128px)

global_state_vars.description: CFont global state is written via Set* methods immediately before PrintString. These are the key static addresses in the 1.0 US exe.

CFont_m_fScaleX.description: Horizontal scale factor. Default 1.0; HUD uses ~0.5

CFont_m_bBackground.description: 1 = render dark background rect behind text

CFont_PrintString.description: Render a null-terminated string at (x, y) using current global state

CFont_GetStringWidth.description: Measure the pixel width of a string using current scale/font
